verdict: Microsoft's revenue rose 18% to $77.7B as Azure grew 40% — but losses on its OpenAI investment held GAAP profit growth to 12%.

segments.name: Productivity and Business Processes
segments.note: Microsoft 365 for businesses (commercial cloud +17%), LinkedIn (+10%) and Dynamics 365 (+18%) — the software businesses sell to companies.

segments.name: Intelligent Cloud
segments.note: Azure cloud computing and server products; Azure revenue grew 40% as AI demand kept building.

segments.name: More Personal Computing
segments.note: Windows licences, Xbox, Surface devices and search ads. Windows OEM and Devices revenue rose 6%, Xbox content and services 1%, and search ads 16% outside traffic costs.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building new products and AI; up 8% YoY.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: The sales force and marketing; flat YoY at $5.7B.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Back-office and legal costs; up 8% YoY.

otherDetail: A net expense of $3,660M, driven by losses on Microsoft's investment in OpenAI, which cut net income by $3.1B after tax. Microsoft's non-GAAP figures strip this impact out.
follow100Note: The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Azure growth accelerated
takeaways.text: Azure revenue grew 40% and Microsoft Cloud reached $49.1B, up 26%. Customers have committed to $392B of future spending (commercial remaining performance obligation, +51%).

takeaways.title: OpenAI losses cut into GAAP profit
takeaways.text: Losses from investments in OpenAI reduced GAAP net income by $3.1B ($0.41 a share). Excluding that (non-GAAP), profit was $30.8B, up 22%, and EPS was $4.13 rather than $3.72.

takeaways.title: Cash returns continued
takeaways.text: Microsoft returned $10.7B to shareholders in dividends and share repurchases during the quarter.

oneTimers: Losses from investments in OpenAI decreased GAAP net income by $3.1B ($0.41 per share) this quarter. Non-GAAP net income excluding the OpenAI impact was $30.8B ($4.13 per share), up 22%.
